fact: A "Line height" control in the properties panel offers presets Tight = 1.0, Normal = 1.25 and Loose = 1.5, plus a field that accepts a typed value from 0.8 to 2.5 in steps of 0.05; the value applies to the whole text element.
source: PO answers 1 and 4 in the issue 99002 session, approved by maxxx 2026-10-13 [answers approved by maxxx at 2026-10-13T09:44:50.216Z, fingerprint d8a28b7d8ea0; change set changes/excalidraw-99002.md]

fact: In the "Line height" field, a value below 0.8 becomes 0.8, a value above 2.5 becomes 2.5, values between steps round to the nearest 0.05, a decimal comma is read as a decimal point, and empty or non-numeric input keeps the previous value.
source: PO answer 4 in the issue 99002 session, approved by maxxx 2026-10-13 [answers approved by maxxx at 2026-10-13T09:44:50.216Z, fingerprint d8a28b7d8ea0; change set changes/excalidraw-99002.md]

fact: New text keeps its font's own line height until a line height is chosen; after that the last chosen value is the default for new text, and a chosen value is kept when the font family or font size changes.
source: PO answers 2, 3 and 8 in the issue 99002 session, approved by maxxx 2026-10-13 [answers approved by maxxx at 2026-10-13T09:44:50.216Z, fingerprint d8a28b7d8ea0; change set changes/excalidraw-99002.md]

fact: A line height preset is highlighted only when the value equals it exactly; with several selected texts at different line heights none is highlighted, and clicking a preset sets that value on all of them.
source: Accepted answer 5 in the issue 99002 session, approved by maxxx 2026-10-13 [answers approved by maxxx at 2026-10-13T09:44:50.216Z, fingerprint d8a28b7d8ea0; change set changes/excalidraw-99002.md]

fact: Changing the line height of text in a shape keeps its wrapping width and makes the shape taller or shorter to fit; an arrow label stays at the middle of the arrow; a sticky note label keeps auto-fitting without overflowing.
source: Accepted answer 6 in the issue 99002 session, approved by maxxx 2026-10-13 [answers approved by maxxx at 2026-10-13T09:44:50.216Z, fingerprint d8a28b7d8ea0; change set changes/excalidraw-99002.md]

fact: Line height survives a page reload, a saved .excalidraw file, PNG and SVG export and live collaboration; older Excalidraw versions opening such files are out of scope.
